description: Renovate for orchestrator-agent: the shared WFO presets plus the rules this application needs. The root uv.lock is copied into the published images and evals/uv.lock runs the benchmark, so dependency updates and lock file maintenance need a review.

packageRules.description: [automerge] httpx is a runtime dependency and in the dev group; review it and propose it nightly

[disable] mkdocs-redirects 1.2.3 depends on properdocs, a MkDocs fork that injects a 'switch away from mkdocs' banner into the built docs; 1.2.2 depends only on mkdocs. Re-enable once a release drops properdocs or the banner

[disable] Keep the Dockerfile on the Python versions that requires-python (>=3.11,<3.14) and the CI test matrix support; patch updates still arrive. A matchDatasources: [docker] rule does NOT match dockerfile dependencies (verified in a dry-run), so match the package name alone
